_meta.description: Wave 9 Batch 1 source-page evidence log. One record per fetch attempt. Only records with result INSPECTED count as inspected-page evidence. BLOCKED fetches and web-search summaries are recorded for transparency but are NOT evidence. Captured values are verbatim quotations returned by the WebFetch tool's page extraction; raw HTML was not stored.
_meta.captureMethod: WebFetch (page converted to text, fields quoted by extraction model). Raw HTML not archived.
_meta.searchSummaryPolicy: Web search was used only to locate candidate URLs. No search-result summary is recorded as evidence.
_meta.evidenceTierPolicy: Repository tier-2 sources: Fragrantica, Basenotes, major authorised retailers. Revision 3: PYRAMID_SECONDARY_SUPPORTED only where a full pyramid matches an inspected brand page, named database or authorised retailer — Versace Yellow Diamond (Nordstrom), Romance (Ulta, corroborated by brand copy), Beautiful (Nordstrom). All others AI_INFERENCE_UNSOURCED. Supplier identity holds are separate.

sourceReliabilityAssessment.thescentbaseAndScentverdict: Third-party fragrance databases of undocumented editorial provenance; not named in the repository tier-2 list. Treated as supplementary only — a match is not sufficient without corroboration from a brand page, named database (Fragrantica/Basenotes) or authorised retailer.

corroborationResults.scentverdict Versace: Corroborated by Nordstrom (same materials and tiers).
corroborationResults.scentverdict Jimmy Choo: Partly contradicted by Nordstrom (Italian orange vs mandarin, caramel vs toffee, no green notes, Tiger Orchid vs Orchid).
corroborationResults.scentverdict The One EDP: Not corroborated; brand page and Nordstrom name Rose, absent from scentverdict.
corroborationResults.thescentbase Poison: Partly corroborated by Nordstrom key notes; Opoponax tier differs.
corroborationResults.thescentbase Gucci Rush: No corroboration obtained (Basenotes 403, gucci.com inaccessible, Amazon unreadable). Basenotes search listing suggests a different pyramid — not inspected, not evidence.

sourceReliabilityAssessment.conclusion: Not equivalent to named tier-2 sources. Records relying on them alone remain AI_INFERENCE_UNSOURCED.

amcalAssessment.repositoryCriterion: Tier 2: 'major authorised retailers (Amazon, Sephora, Kohl's, Nordstrom, authorized boutiques)'.
amcalAssessment.finding: Amcal is a national Australian pharmacy retail banner, not one of the named examples. The inspected page does not establish that it is an authorised Tommy Hilfiger fragrance stockist, and authorised status could not be verified from an accessible source. Tommy Hilfiger regional brand pages (timed out) are indicated by search listings to describe a reformulated current EDT.
amcalAssessment.decision: Amcal evidence does not meet the authorised-retailer criterion as demonstrable. Tommy Girl reverts to AI_INFERENCE_UNSOURCED.
